bio: Settle in for a cosy dinner in this characterful property nestled beside a little river and dating back to 1849. Each month, Ruben Coonen unveils a new surprise menu, continually justifying his guests' faith in his culinary talents and wine recommendations. Whether he serves up a tender piece of veal with an aromatic jus de cuisson, or a pristine cod fillet with the fine nuances of a dashi vinaigrette, his market-fresh cuisine is at times intricate and always brimming with flavour....
